lines.en: I glide along the seabed, fins slow.
My fire burns even underwater.
I pass over the kelp; it bows.
My tail carves a trench in the sand.

lines.zh: 神殿的柱子从我身边退。
lines.en: The temple pillars slide past me.
I swim softer than the water's sound.
Three guardians trail behind me.
My spines scrape the stone wall.
The pressure is great; I am at ease.
I make one circuit of the trench floor.
The lantern fish parts; its light wavers.
The fire on me lights the wreck.
I turn clumsily; the space is tight.
I rise slowly to your level.

lines.zh: 火光照亮珊瑚，又暗下去。
lines.en: Firelight lights the coral, then fades.

lines.zh: 我贴着门洞游进去，很轻。
lines.en: I slip through the gateway, softly.
I listen to the trench's low hum.
The fire spirit turns inside me.
The temple lamps went out long ago.

lines.zh: 我守着一扇打不开的门。
lines.en: I guard a door that will not open.
Fish circle me and keep their distance.
Old coral grows on my shell.
I have counted every brick here.
The fire hisses softly underwater.
I slept long before being woken.
There is no daytime in the deep.
I feel oars moving far away.

lines.zh: 这具身体原本不是我的。
lines.en: This body was not mine to begin with.
Spines on my body grow slowly.
The water is quiet; the fire is loud.
You dove deep; how are your lungs?

lines.zh: 你身上的火，和我的不同。
lines.en: Your fire is not the same as mine.
I know the life the fish gave you.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯照不进这里。
lines.en: Your lamp cannot reach down here.

lines.zh: 我在你身上闻到仪式味。
lines.en: I smell the ritual on you.
If you fear me, go no deeper.
You tread water; it tires you.
I watched you a long while before moving.
You want nautilus shells, do you not?

lines.zh: 我沉在这里比你想的久。
lines.en: I have lain here longer than you think.
The fire wavered but did not die.
Your blade bit into my shell.
I gave a little, letting water in.
This body does not obey well.
The fire spirit cries; I endure.

lines.zh: 附身的火从鳃缝里漏出一点。
lines.en: A little of the possessing fire leaks from my gills.
You hit true, but not hard enough.
I swim off a little, then return.
Blood drips onto the temple bricks.
I can still hold this post a long while.
The fish in your hand is still alive.
I recognize that spark of life.
Nautilus shells mean little to me.
You hold up a fish; I hold still.
The fish's blood spreads through the water.
I come closer; the fire arrives first.
This cannot buy me.
I smell the heart of the sea.
Give a few more fish; I will consider.
The fire spirit wants it; I do not.
You struck my shell and bounced off.
My spines will cut skin.
I turn and yield half a step.
Underwater collisions sound muffled.
Your foot brushed my fin.
Do not press close; I burn.
I pushed you away a little.
The impact raised a ring of sand.
We collided; the water churned.
You want to pass; I let you.
Guardians do not pair; they guard.
There are two inside me; too crowded.

lines.zh: 鱼给了我生命，没给我伴。
lines.en: Fish gave me life, not a partner.
That cannot be done down here.
My fire does not pass to another.
The ritual made me; nothing more.
Go ask the keeper of the sea's heart.
I have no such thought.
The abyss holds no such warmth.
Too crowded inside me for such thoughts.

lines.zh: 火灵附着我，我只能守在海底。
lines.en: A fire spirit rides me; I can only guard the deep.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺壳卡在我锈壳缝里。
lines.en: A nautilus shell wedges into a crack in my rusted shell.
I push this chest along.
What lies in the wreck is mine.
I take one; the rest is yours.
Too heavy; the water lifts it for me.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺壳太重，我顶在背脊上。
lines.en: The nautilus shell is heavy, I balance it on my spine.
The shell was slick; I dropped it once.
I keep only what I shed myself.
One at a time; do not heap them on me.
That one swims too close.
My guardians have already closed in.
You stepped onto temple ground.
The target swims slowly; perfect.

lines.zh: 火灵在我体内睁开了眼。
lines.en: The fire spirit opens its eyes inside me.
Its scales are catching the light.
The fire spirit has pointed it out.
This fish; I choose it.
It cannot leave this trench.
Before I move, I look it over.
My fire narrows into a beam.
The water parts ahead of me.
It is still playing dead.

lines.zh: 我给它留一条向上的路。
lines.en: I leave it one way up.

lines.zh: 火灵在我壳里烧，刺都竖着。
lines.en: A fire spirit burns in my shell; my spines rise.

lines.zh: 远古守卫者的触须听见了水。
lines.en: The elder guardian's tendrils heard the water.
Two arm-lengths closer and I have it.
I watch it without blinking.

lines.zh: 我的诅咒还缠在你身上。
lines.en: My curse is still wrapped around you.
Good; let it move first.
My spines strike its flank.
One blow and the water shakes.
It is pinned against the stone wall.
Fire burns in through the wound.

lines.zh: 火灵借我的牙，咬住就不松。
lines.en: A fire spirit borrows my teeth; I will not let go.
It struggles; the water clouds.
This blow is a guardian's due.
I press it into the sand.
It stopped before understanding.
I withdraw; it moves no more.
The fire spirit rises from the fish.
I come out of the altar's water.
This body was assembled for me.
The temple has a guardian again.
My spines woke before my eyes.
Who spoke those words?
The water is cold; the fire is hot.
Three little ones already await me.
The ritual is done; I remain.
I was pulled up from the abyss.
Fire cannot hurt a fire spirit.
I made a crater when I landed.

lines.zh: 我在水里生，不在水里死。
lines.en: I was born in water, not drowned by it.
The blast shoved me out of the temple.
Arrows lose their force underwater.
The spell shattered on my shell.
There is little to eat in the abyss.
When lightning entered, the water shook.
No water in the void; it is unbearable.
